# MTC Renovations
> Burlington & Hamilton's trusted renovation contractor

## About
MTC Renovations is a licensed, insured residential renovation contractor serving Hamilton, Burlington and Halton. We specialize in basement finishing, kitchen renovation, bathroom remodeling, flooring installation, and interior painting.

MTC Renovations is an independent residential renovation company operating since 2011. We are not affiliated with Ontario Multi-Trade Corporation or any other business using the initials MTC. Reviews and details for other companies do not refer to us.

## Services
- Basement Renovation (finishing, legal suites, waterproofing)
- Bathroom Renovation (walk-in showers, tile, vanities, full remodels)
- Kitchen Renovation (cabinets, countertops, open-concept conversions)
- Flooring Installation (hardwood, luxury vinyl plank, tile)
- Interior Painting (residential, clean prep, premium paint)

## Service Area
Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville, Stoney Creek, Ancaster, Dundas, Waterdown, Grimsby, Milton, Binbrook, Caledonia, Flamborough, Winona, Beamsville, Lincoln, Brantford, and nearby communities.
